subject: Data Engineering
title: Reverse ETL
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Reverse ETL.

hook.text: Data flows into the warehouse. But marketing needs it back in Salesforce. Enter reverse ETL.

buildup.text: Reverse ETL pushes transformed data from the warehouse back into operational tools like CRMs and ad platforms.

discovery.text: Tools like Census and Hightouch sync warehouse tables to SaaS tools, activating analytics data in real time.

twist.text: The warehouse becomes the single source of truth. Operational tools become consumers, not owners, of data.

climax.text: Reverse ETL closes the loop: ingest data, transform it, then push insights back to where decisions happen.

punchline.text: Data in. Insights out. Back where they're needed.

quiz.question: What does reverse ETL do?
options: Pushes transformed warehouse data back into operational tools
Moves data from the warehouse to cold storage
